name: rtor.rizal
title: RTOR
description: RTOR GHOSTCHAIN cryptoclient 0.2.3 for Ubuntu Touch: always-on seed and leech (>= 1 KB/s each way, measured) of .rzl, crypto, RTOR and magnet files with LAN RTOR peers (Neo, Pixel) and public RTRACKR. UI loopback only (127.0.0.1:4984); peer port 4985 LAN only. Unsigned; re-seed waits for Rizal's RGHOSTKEY tap.
